invariants.rationale: The method assigns a JavaUpsertPartitioner (via cast) to this.partitioner and returns it.
this.partitioner is set to the result of (JavaUpsertPartitioner) super.getUpsertPartitioner(profile), so its type is JavaUpsertPartitioner if assignment succeeds.
A non-null value is required as (JavaUpsertPartitioner) cast and assignment are performed, and then the result is returned.
this.partitioner is assigned before returning, so it cannot be null if the method completes normally.
